notes.en: Documentation snapshot. Execution remains disabled until catalog, account, cost, and entitlement are verified by preflight.

notes.en: Provisional profile: marketing ceiling ~40 s (`maxDurationMs`). The operational campaign may use a lower ceiling. Do not submit jobs without preflight.

notes.en: Provisional snapshot for combined storyboard sheets. Output sizes must be verified on the account/API in use; in-repo execution remains disabled.

notes.en: Segments up to 30 s (conservative operational ceiling). The Seedance 2.5 snapshot documents up to 40 s; preflight must confirm the account's real ceiling.
